title: SourceCodeAction
responsibility: Opens one selected source file through its host without changing detail navigation.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.entity
inputs.description: Entity whose owned files should be read.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.nav
inputs.description: Revision-scoped navigation including an optional source callback.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.title
inputs.description: Optional displayed callable or entity name.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.path
inputs.description: The owned file selected by this row; its contents appear first in the modal.

outputs.name: SourceCodeAction
outputs.description: A file-specific View code button. Opening retains the selected commit and address; closing restores focus to this row.
